# The Verex Book

User documentation for Verex, the Lean-hosted verifier for Move (and Rust).
This book is for expert users: it describes the languages and workflows
concisely, with working examples, and leaves the models, decisions, and
rationale to the design documents in [`../designs/`](../designs/).

1. [VerexSL, the source language](verex-sl.md) — the profile-aware source
   language, its Move profile, and specifications.
2. [The proof language](proof-language.md) — writing proofs for obligations
   the automatic verification does not close.
